data.name: Medovox
data.detailed_description:
Medovox is a cozy life simulator and open-world sandbox. Take control of your farm, complete quests, and explore nature. Enjoy complete freedom, build your dream home, and immerse yourself in countryside tranquility!

Your Farm, Your Rules The main goal of the game is simply to live. Customize your land and develop your farm at your own comfortable pace. There are no strict restrictions in this sandbox — you decide exactly how to manage your world and what to do each day.

Open World and Wildlife Get behind the wheel and set off on a journey across a seamless open world. Explore picturesque locations, take on diverse quests, and observe wildlife in their natural habitat. The road is open for any expedition.

Cozy Low-Poly Style Minimalist low-poly graphics are brought to life with deep, sophisticated lighting and a realistic day-night cycle. Thanks to this advanced lighting system, the visuals are vibrant, dimensional, and incredibly atmospheric — whether in the soft glow of early morning or the warm hues of sunset.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6400 or AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 Ti or AMD Radeon RX 570
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Windows Compatible
  • Additional Notes: SSD is highly recommended for a stable framerate and smoother loading times.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-10400 or AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1080 or AMD Radeon RX 5700 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Windows Compatible
  • Additional Notes: NVMe M.2 SSD is recommended for the best performance and optimal experience.

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:

  • Processor: Apple M2
  • Memory: 8 GB GB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple M2 (8-core GPU)
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:

  • Processor: Apple M3 Pro

  • Graphics: Apple M3 Pro (14-core GPU)
